description: The run cases of `cargo xtask parity script`: the form-free scripts of the 4.1.5q `Edit Scripts` folder (the 32 that use a form are covered by the port's form shim instead). A case names the game and the plugins to load (defaults below); `close_after` closes the GUI after the script, so `SaveChanged` writes the plugins it changed into the private data folder and their bytes are compared with the port's. A case with `build_refs` has the oracle build the reference information after loading (the script reads `ReferencedBy`); the port is told the same. Scripts classed interactive are listed for completeness and deferred unless named with --script.
